+# Doctor V2 Stage5 A01 九分区几何 R1 强审任务书
+
+## 1. 审查决策边界
+
+本轮只审查毛孔模块 01 的 `1024×1024` anatomical envelope 和九分区纯几何实现。输入只有内存中人工构造的 `478×2 float32` 坐标；快照中不含人脸图片、MediaPipe 产物、真实 Mask、overlay、评分或 Word。
+
+本轮结论最高只能授权下一个有界的纯算法/Mask 支持域实现窗口，不能授权：
+
+- 创建生产 authority root。
+- 读取或解码真实 `RGB-Core13`。
+- 运行 MediaPipe、旧毛孔 detector 或十三例。
+- 持久化 Mask、label、overlay、评分或 Word。
+- 给予视觉、医学、正式报告、合并、推送或部署通过。
+
+Stage5 授权合同 R2 的不可变 manifest SHA256 必须是 `7f5183aef9312f787a8073dd3df2b41bbfacc8c506dff2f197b8ae8b296452ee`，且其 `15/15 CLOSED`、真实数据与算法仍禁行的边界不得被本轮覆盖。
+
+## 2. 必审的 16 项要求
+
+| ID | 必须独立复核的事实 |
+|---|---|
+| `A01-GEOM-INPUT-01` | 入口只接受恰好 478 个二维 `float32` finite 坐标；先 clip 到 `[0,1023]`，再用 NumPy `rint` ties-to-even 转 `int32`，不修改输入。 |
+| `A01-GEOM-HULL-02` | `base_face_mask` 必须仅由全部 478 个整数点的 OpenCV convex hull 以 `LINE_8/shift=0/255` 填充。 |
+| `A01-GEOM-FOREHEAD-03` | 额头 7 个必需 landmark、`0.8`、`0.38`、六点顺序、clip/rint/hull/fill 必须与冻结设计逐字节等价。 |
+| `A01-GEOM-ENVELOPE-04` | 全脸 hull 只用 `7×7` OpenCV 椭圆核膨胀一次，再与额头 polygon OR；不得 close、blur、平滑或读取颜色/皮肤/展示 Mask。 |
+| `A01-GEOM-FAIL-05` | 非finite、形状/dtype、左右顺序、额头上界、中面部边界、退化 hull、空区、越界/重叠/未覆盖都必须统一 fail-closed 为 `REGION_GEOMETRY_FAILED`。 |
+| `A01-GEOM-AXES-06` | 中心 x 只取 landmark 1 浮点 x；上界取 105/334 浮点 y 最小值；下界取 61/291/0/17 浮点 y 均值；三个纵向区间的严格/闭合边界必须正确。 |
+| `A01-GEOM-NOSE-07` | 鼻部只用固定 `NOSE_LANDMARKS` hull、`31×31` 椭圆核膨胀一次，并限制在中面部与 envelope 之内。 |
+| `A01-GEOM-ROW-08` | 每个中面部扫描行的左/右端点只从独立 envelope 获取；不得读 `valid_skin`、遮挡、五官洞、毛发或颜色。 |
+| `A01-GEOM-BUCKET-09` | 左右 t 公式、3 px 最小分母、finite、`1e-6` 越界容差以及 `[0,1/3)`/`[1/3,2/3)`/`[2/3,1]` 半开区间必须机械一致。 |
+| `A01-GEOM-PARTITION-10` | 鼻部优先，随后额部/下巴/左右中面部；9 区必须全部非空、两两互斥，并集逐像素等于 envelope。 |
+| `A01-GEOM-IMMUTABLE-11` | 输出 landmark、envelope 和九区 Mask 为连续只读数组；映射只读；面积、逐 Mask raw SHA256 可复算。 |
+| `A01-GEOM-DETERMINISM-12` | 同一合成坐标两次运行逐像素一致；冻结 envelope hash、9 个面积与 9 个区域 hash 全部与测试基线一致。 |
+| `A01-GEOM-ISOLATION-13` | 两个公开几何入口仅有 `landmarks` 参数；源码不得导入/读写 MediaPipe、图像、输出目录、`valid_skin`、display 或 score 对象。 |
+| `A01-GEOM-REGRESSION-14` | Stage5 授权 19 项、Stage2 71 项、Stage3 15 项、Stage4 证据 20 项、Worker 43 个序列化测试 + 522 subtests 必须在独立新进程中全部通过。 |
+| `A01-GEOM-FAILHISTORY-15` | 合并回归的 2 个失败 XML 必须原样保留并定性：Stage4 v5 旧封存包的 HEAD 绑定拒绝、同进程测试顺序导致 `sys.modules` 前置条件不成立。不得删除该证据，也不得未审先称它们“无影响”。 |
+| `A01-GEOM-BOUNDARY-16` | 快照必须是不超过 25 MiB 的纯文本/源码/XML 闭包，0 图片、0原图根扫描、0无关 PID 管理，只启动 1 名只读强审。 |
+
+## 3. 必须显式判断的文档歧义
+
+设计第 5 节的概括句写有“必需坐标越界即 fail-closed”，但随后冻结的第 1 条逐像素算法明确要求“对每个 x/y 先 clip 到 `[0,1023]`，再 `rint`”。当前实现遵循后者。强审必须判断这是可由更精确编号算法解释的文字卫生问题，还是会改变真实行为的合同冲突。如无法从封存证据唯一确定，必须标记为证据不足/阻断，不得猜 PASS。
+
+## 4. 审查方法与输出
+
+强审必须两次独立复算 manifest/sidecar、每个文件的路径/大小/SHA/权限、dirty 闭包和 JUnit 真实计数；对 16 项逐项输出 `CLOSED | OPEN | BLOCKED`。问题按 P0/P1/P2 列出需求 ID、文件/行、实际值、期望值、证据、影响、复现、允许修改层级和置信度。
+
+七门必须独立给出：工程、来源/隐私、正式报告、视觉、医学、资源、Review manifest。“测试通过”不得覆盖正式报告/视觉/医学仍阻断的事实。

  5. 必须验证54在284左侧、103在332左侧、upper_y严格小于brow_y、envelope非空且所有后续region都在其内；失败即`REGION_GEOMETRY_FAILED`。
  6. 该算法由唯一版本化函数`build_pore_anatomical_envelope_v1`实现；运行回执同时绑定函数所在文件SHA和完整Stage5 code-state root，文档公式与函数常量任一漂移都由合同测试拒绝。
- 中心线固定为landmark 1的浮点x；额部/中面部边界为`min(landmark105.y, landmark334.y)`；中面部/下巴边界为landmark`61,291,0,17`的y均值。像素中心y严格小于上界属于额部，`brow_y ≤ y ≤ mouth_y`属于中面部，严格大于下界属于下巴。
- 鼻部anatomical mask使用固定`NOSE_LANDMARKS`顺序的凸包、31×31椭圆核膨胀一次，并限制在中面部与独立anatomical envelope内；分配优先级为鼻部→额部→下巴→左右中面部。
- 每个中面部扫描行只读取独立anatomical envelope。画面左侧端点为该行`x < centre_x`的最小x，右侧端点为`x ≥ centre_x`的最大x；不读取valid skin，因此遮挡、五官洞或毛发不会移动边界。
- 左侧归一化位置为`(centre_x - x)/(centre_x - left_outer_x)`，右侧为`(x - centre_x)/(right_outer_x - centre_x)`。分母不足3像素、某侧无端点或结果非finite时整次几何失败。
- 半开区间固定为：`0 ≤ t < 1/3`鼻旁；`1/3 ≤ t < 2/3`内侧面颊；`2/3 ≤ t ≤ 1`外侧面颊。直接比较浮点像素中心，不对边界取整；超出`[0,1]`超过`1e-6`即失败。
- 鼻Mask已先占用，其余中面部像素再按上述区间分配；anatomical envelope内不得存在未分配或多重分配像素。口唇、鼻孔和其他洞只在随后与valid skin求交时扣除，不改变anatomical masks。
- 旧统一scope仍决定实际分析ROI，但必须有真实closed contour，禁止fallback。九个valid region为`anatomical_region ∩ analysis_roi ∩ valid_skin`；九区必须互斥且并集严格等于旧检测使用的Stage5分析分母，否则样本失败。
- 以上`1/3、2/3`仅定义工程分区，不宣称解剖学界线；后续若医生修改，必须升级ontology版本，不能静默改旧结果。

区域可用门沿用已冻结的稳定性原则：

- 有效像素不少于2000；
- 有效像素/anatomical mask像素不少于50%；
- 否则该区`UNAVAILABLE`，全部指标、分区分数和相关左右比较为`null + reason_codes`。

## 6. 指标及空值语义

### 6.1 可输出工程指标

每个有效区域和全面部输出：

- 可见毛孔数量；
- 单位面积密度（个/10万有效皮肤像素）；
- 唯一support总面积与面积占比；
- 实例面积P50、P90和最大值；
- 圆度P50、低圆度比例；
- 长宽比P50、椭圆形比例、拉长样比例；
- 中心—环带对比度平均值、P50和P90；
- 有效面积、anatomical面积、有效覆盖率、实例数稳定性状态。

百分位固定使用NumPy `method="linear"`；面积、对比度、圆度和长宽比均只使用finite实例值。工程形态阈值固定为旧链现有阈值的版本化副本：低圆度`circularity < 0.5`、椭圆样`aspect_ratio ≥ 1.35`、拉长样`aspect_ratio ≥ 2.0`，并始终标记`ENGINEERING_THRESHOLD_V1_NOT_MEDICAL`。

逐字段实例稳定性矩阵：

| 实例数N | count/density/support area/area ratio | max area | area/contrast P50 | area/contrast P90 | morphology P50与三项工程比例 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `0`，AVAILABLE | null，`NO_INSTANCES` | null，`INSTANCE_COUNT_LT_5` | null，`INSTANCE_COUNT_LT_10` | null，`INSTANCE_COUNT_LT_10` |
| 1–4 | AVAILABLE | AVAILABLE | null，`INSTANCE_COUNT_LT_5` | null，`INSTANCE_COUNT_LT_10` | null，`INSTANCE_COUNT_LT_10` |
| 5–9 | AVAILABLE | AVAILABLE | AVAILABLE | null，`INSTANCE_COUNT_LT_10` | null，`INSTANCE_COUNT_LT_10` |
| 10–19 | AVAILABLE并附`LOW_STABILITY_N_LT_20` | AVAILABLE | AVAILABLE | AVAILABLE并附低稳定性 | AVAILABLE并附低稳定性 |
| ≥20 | AVAILABLE | AVAILABLE | AVAILABLE | AVAILABLE | AVAILABLE |

中心—环带对比度平均值与P50使用相同的N≥5门，P90使用N≥10门。support面积占比不受实例比例门影响。医生原文中的“规则圆形毛孔比例”和“高对比度毛孔数量/比例”在阈值未标定前均为required null，分别带`ROUND_SHAPE_THRESHOLD_NOT_CALIBRATED`和`HIGH_CONTRAST_THRESHOLD_NOT_CALIBRATED`，不得省略。

有效区域内真实零检出时，数量、密度和support面积为0；分位数及形态指标仍因无实例为null，禁止用0冒充。

只比较：

- 左/右鼻旁；
- 左/右内侧面颊；
- 左/右外侧面颊。

每对输出右减左的带符号差和绝对差：密度、面积占比、P90实例面积、低圆度比例、拉长样比例。大毛孔差异保持null。任一侧不可用时整对`UNAVAILABLE`，不得以另一侧或0补齐。

## 8. RGB与PP

- `consumer_rgb`：RGB为唯一主证据；PP状态固定`ABSENT + ROUTE_HAS_NO_PP`。

# DermaVision 双路线、医生 V2 十一维、显示风格与强审查落地总方案

## 一、会审结论与当前基线

本方案已由主代理、双路线架构代理、强审查代理和资源安全代理反复交叉审查。最终结论：

## 二、双输入路线与公共架构

### 2.1 输入路线

| 路线 | 输入 | 用途 | 入口规则 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `consumer_rgb` | 单张普通白光/RGB 正面照 | 普通用户 | 显式单文件入口 |
| `clinic_four_light` | RGB、PP、CP、365 正面 `_M` 图 | 仪器、医美内部研发 | 必须通过签名 manifest 和已注册 `DeviceProfile` |

禁止根据文件名、目录中文件数量或图像颜色自动猜测路线。

`clinic_four_light` 的 RGB 是硬必需通道：

- RGB 缺失、损坏、签名/哈希不符、主体或拍摄会话不一致、白光 QC 失败、人脸/几何失败时，整次运行直接拒绝，零检测、零融合、零评分、零 Word。
- PP、CP、365 缺失或失败时才允许逐通道、逐模块降级。
- PP 失败：RGB 主检测仍可运行，但 PP 增强证据不可用。
- CP 失败：依赖 CP 的色素、血管、红区 head 不可用，不能用 RGB 冒充仪器主证据。
- 365 失败：UV、紫质、油光融合标记不可用或部分可用，不能写成零。
- 配准失败：允许保留该通道的独立观察；所有重叠、共定位和融合字段必须为空并带原因码。

PP 更适合增强表面纹理、细纹、毛孔等表现，CP 更适合观察亚表面色素和血管，但这些文献只能支持路线设计，不能证明当前仪器等价或算法已经有效。[偏振面部成像综述](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10988667/)、[PP/CP 对照研究](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25689808/)

365 必须先确认实际成像是荧光还是反射；紫质荧光不得直接等同油脂，油光与紫质必须保持两个独立证据 head。[UV/紫质相关研究](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41274329/)

### 2.2 核心数据结构

新增内部结构：

- `CaptureBundle`
- `DeviceProfile`
- `ChannelObservation`
- `RegistrationEvidence`
- `DetectorObservation`
- `ClinicalModuleResult`
- `ReviewBundleManifest`

`CaptureBundle` 固定记录匿名主体 ID、采集会话 ID、设备/固件配置、视角、通道角色、文件哈希、采集时间、来源和坐标空间。

四个注册表严格分离：

- `DeviceCapabilityRegistry`
- `ModalityRouteRegistry`
- `DetectorCapabilityRegistry`
- `DoctorRequirementRegistry`

每次运行冻结全部注册表的版本、内容哈希和相互引用关系。报告必须使用运行时快照，不能读取“最新配置”替换历史结果。

### 2.3 正交状态，不再互相覆盖

运行级硬门禁：

```text
REJECTED_MANIFEST
> REJECTED_DEVICE
> REJECTED_PROVENANCE_SESSION
> REJECTED_RGB_INPUT
> REJECTED_GEOMETRY
> ACCEPTED
```

前五项按严重度短路；只有 `ACCEPTED` 才运行检测。

每个非 RGB 通道独立记录：

```text
ABSENT | QC_FAILED | REGISTRATION_FAILED | ALGORITHM_FAILED | AVAILABLE
```

证据状态：

```text
UNAVAILABLE | SHADOW | ENGINEERING_PASSED | MEDICAL_PASSED
```

模块状态：

```text
NOT_ASSESSABLE | PARTIAL | ENGINEERING_READY | MEDICAL_READY
```

每个模块另有独立报告资格：

```text
NOT_REPORTABLE | INTERNAL_ONLY | CLINICAL_ELIGIBLE
```

`CLINICAL_ELIGIBLE` 同时允许内部查看，不会被 `INTERNAL_ONLY` 阻断。程序不得自动把 `ENGINEERING_PASSED` 提升为 `MEDICAL_PASSED`。

工程、来源、视觉、医学、报告、标定、评分是独立门禁。某模块不输出评分时，标定/评分门必须由医生需求注册表明确标记 `NOT_APPLICABLE`，不能静默跳过。

### 2.4 对外兼容

本轮不修改：

- Worker 五字段信封。
- `meta_data.version="1"`。
- 现有五项算法和 `purple` 返回结构。
- 现有后端 API 字段。

四光源路线先作为本地内部 manifest runner。未来如需进入云端 Worker，必须另开 API 版本并与后端同步部署，不能塞入现有 v1 信封。

## 三、医生 V2 十一维路线

当前九项检测是工程 observation，不等于十一项独立医学构念。固定十一项 ID 如下：

| ID | 医生需求 | 短期路线与边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 01 | 毛孔 | RGB 主检测、PP 增强；升级现有 pores，统一毛囊中心坐标和分母 |
| 02 | 油光 | RGB `SurfaceGloss` 仅候选；clinic 拆为 `pp_reflection_candidate` 与 `uv365_physical_attribution`，未分别通过前不融合、不评分 |
| 03 | 综合色素 | RGB 可做可见斑；CP 为仪器色素候选；365 仅在物理属性确认后使用；现有 RGB brown 只能标记 proxy/shadow |
| 04 | 弥漫性泛红 | RGB/CP 候选，但必须扣除血管、痤疮和局部炎症证据后才允许汇总 |
| 05 | 血管 | 现有白光方案视为失败候选；重做 CP 主证据加 RGB 可见性校验，未验证前不得进入正式报告 |
| 06 | 痤疮 | RGB 形态、CP 红区、PP 表面隆起和合格的 365 紫质证据；毛囊中心依赖 01 |
| 07 | 干燥细纹 | 新建独立 head，RGB 主、PP 增强；只有正面图时完整 V2 可保持 `PARTIAL` |
| 08 | 稳定性皱纹 | 医生需求名保留；当前证据仅叫 `FrontWrinkleAppearance2DSupplement`，永远标记 `insufficient_for_full_v2` |
| 09 | 结构性沟纹 | 医生需求名保留；当前证据仅叫 `FrontGrooveAppearance2DSupplement`，禁止深度、体积和完整构念声明 |
| 10 | 光滑度 | 不能把现有 texture 改名为光滑度；新增 `SurfaceIrregularityAppearance2D`，分别建隆起、凹陷、附着物和排除证据；内部不规则负担与“越高越光滑”的医生分数分开 |

08、09、11 的完整医学构念需要侧面、多角度、深度或 3D 信息。本阶段 L/R、IR、Depth、3D 只做库存登记，不进入算法和正式结论。

所有十一项始终出现在内部报告状态表中。证据不足必须显示缺少的通道、视角或验证，不得解释为“未发现问题”，也不得给出分数、等级或护理方案。

## 四、数据、报告、显示风格与评分

### 4.1 数据集划分

现有数据全部纳入清点，但用途严格分层：

- `RGB-Core13`：3 张 VISIA 加现有固定 10 张样本，作为已知回归和灾难问题集，不称为盲测。十张固定为样本 01–10：`636956_1、546210_0、909961_1、732696_1、610382_1、738098_1、584318_1、1075934_1、889866_1、1013197_1`，manifest 记录完整路径和哈希。
- `RGB-Retrospective13`：3 张已知 VISIA 加 10 张经文件哈希、主体身份双重去重的候选；如不能证明从未暴露，则整组只算回顾性集。
- `RGB-Blind13`：未来新增 13 个此前未暴露、身份去重的独立主体，算法首次运行前冻结。
- `Clinic-Engineering28`：现有 28 次仪器采集全部使用，其中18套完整四通道、1套固定作为365受阻降级测试、9套固定作为无脸/构图失败拒绝测试。
- `Clinic-SubjectRank-N-Pilot`：每个经数据所有者确认的独立主体只选一套完整采集；重复拍摄只评估重复性，不扩大独立样本数。
- `Clinic-Blind13`：未来新增13个身份去重、完整四光源独立主体。

现有压缩包共1233个文件，当前只让112张正面 `_M` 图进入双路线；其他视角、深度、IR、厂商 BROWN/RED/REDNE、日志和模型只做来源库存。原始人脸、PII 和详细 manifest 放在受控、非 Git 区域；Git 只保留 schema、匿名统计和哈希。

### 4.2 内部报告

四光源第一版报告固定命名为“内部研发盲审包”，封面明确：

- 非用户报告。
- 非医疗结论。
- 未评分。
- 不可外发。

报告包含路线、设备配置、通道 QC、配准、来源和十一维状态矩阵。白光与 PP、白光与 CP 只在对应模块获准时双列展示；增强图不产生第二套评分。

普通 RGB 报告不出现空的 PP/CP/365 占位。当前 RGB UV、紫质或综合色素代理必须标记 `rgb_proxy_shadow`，不得冒充真实仪器模态。

### 4.3 SkinMapLocal 只迁移显示风格

不迁移 SkinMapLocal 的算法、Mask、阈值、回归、评分、标定参数、厂商术语、REDNE 或 `XingerEngine`。

新组件命名为 `AisiaEvidenceStyleRenderer`，首期仅生成内部 `display_artifact`：

- `AISIA泛红证据显示图` → `red_style_map.jpg`
- `AISIA色素证据显示图` → `brown_style_map.jpg`

渲染权限固定：

- 最大着色范围为 `analysis_roi_mask ∩ evidence_support_mask`。
- `face_matte` 只能缩小可见范围。
- `display_contour` 只负责画边界，不能生成或扩张证据。
- `score_map` 必须携带范围、单位、归一化域、算法版本和 schema 哈希。
- 逐图归一化必须标记 `within_image_relative`，禁止跨样本比较。
- 色阶映射固定，禁止逐图百分位、自动对比度、直方图匹配和厂商回归。
- 高频纹理只能按固定尺度、固定强度调制亮度，不得改变色相或饱和度，并必须做无纹理消融测试。

在 IP 和数据权属未确认前，只允许内部 A/B。若不能取得授权，严格清洁室流程采用双角色交接：规格角色只能输出不含代码、数值、厂商命名、Mask 和样例像素的抽象视觉规范；实现角色不得接触 SkinMapLocal 代码、模型、资产和回归数据。由于主代理已经做过技术盘点，主代理实现的版本只能作为内部独立重绘，不能对外宣称法律意义上的 clean-room 成果。

样式图不得参与疾病负担、排序或评分，也不得替换 clinic 报告证据栏。进入用户 Word 前必须通过工程、来源、视觉、报告门、盲式 A/B、用户版式选择和医生“无医学误读”签署；权威 overlay 始终保留在医生正文或证据附录。

### 4.4 旧评分统计的使用

现有约38,657条记录属于旧全脸、旧 ROI、旧算法和旧指标定义。去重、PASS 后的数据仍只能用于 legacy profile，不能直接给新 ROI 或四光源算法打分。

评分配置键固定为：

```text
route
+ device_profile
+ roi_profile
+ algorithm_version
+ metric_definition_version
```

评分最后实施：

1. 冻结旧链路和 legacy profile。
2. 在同一批重叠样本上同时运行旧、新指标。
3. 只有映射误差和排序门同时通过，才建立有版本号的单调 bridge。
4. bridge 不能跨 consumer/clinic、设备配置或 ROI 使用。
5. 不通过则建立全新 profile；历史趋势不得静默拼接。
6. `UNAVAILABLE` 不是0分。
7. 不生成十一维总分。

VISIA2 当前 `77.10` 在画线修复阶段逐字段保持不变，不人工调低，也不当作新算法已校准的证明；旧报告中的70多分只能按对应历史 profile 追溯。算法和 ROI 未冻结前不重新跑正式评分。

## 五、验收规则与强审查

### 5.1 单份报告门禁

每个模块、每个样本都必须核对：

- 输入、通道、ROI、Mask、分母、单位和坐标空间。
- 算法原始输出与 JSON/CSV 一致。
- JSON/CSV 与 Word 数值、文字、结论、日期一致。
- Word 嵌图确实来自本次运行并可由哈希追踪。
- 不可用、部分可用和完整可用的措辞正确。
- 无证据扩张、错位、反色、方向颠倒或错误医学命名。

### 5.2 13例横向排序

`Blind13` 只作为独立工程 pilot 和统计流程 go/no-go，不单独授予 `MEDICAL_PASSED`。

预冻结门槛：

- 每个 `module × route × DeviceProfile` 至少10个独立可评估主体。
- hard pair 定义为两名医生冻结后的严重度等级差 `≥2`。
- 所有符合定义的 hard pair 必须纳入，禁止事后挑选；有效 hard pair 至少8对。
- 严重反转数必须为0；出现1个即 P0。
- Pair concordance 点估计 `≥0.80`，主体级 bootstrap 95% CI 下界 `≥0.70`。
- Spearman 使用 midrank，点估计 `≥0.70`，主体级 bootstrap 95% CI 下界 `≥0.50`。
- ties、abstain、不可评估和有效主体数分别报告。
- 重复采集和同一主体产生的 pair 按主体聚类；只有每主体一个独立二元结果时才可使用普通 Wilson 区间。
- 独立主体、有效 pair 或稳定 CI 不足，一律为 `insufficient_evidence`。

正式医学验证前，由医生和统计负责人按每个模块、路线、设备配置，依据临床允许误差、预期效应、严重反转上限、等级分布和失访率预注册样本量、正式门槛和统计脚本。两名医生独立标注；等级差≥2或方向冲突时由第三名医生仲裁。

### 5.3 唯一强审查代理

规划阶段使用的架构和安全代理在本方案确认后关闭；实施阶段只保留一个强审查角色配置：

```toml
[agents]
enabled = false
max_concurrent_threads_per_session = 1
default_subagent_model = "gpt-5.6-sol"
default_subagent_reasoning_effort = "xhigh"
```

强审查代理文件再次写死：

```toml
model = "gpt-5.6-sol"
model_reasoning_effort = "xhigh"
sandbox_mode = "read-only"
```

官方文档确认 `[agents] enabled`、并发上限和自定义代理的模型、推理强度、只读沙箱均为受支持配置；`gpt-5.6-sol + xhigh` 保持用户指定的高强度，不做 Token 降级。[OpenAI 子代理配置](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/agent-configuration/subagents)、[GPT‑5.6 模型说明](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/latest-model)

这里的“保留”是保留角色定义，不是持续运行：

1. 默认 `enabled=false`。
2. 主代理停止算法和图片任务，生成不可变、有界审查 manifest。
3. 资源门通过后，单次审查窗口临时启用，最多1名 reviewer。
4. 审查完成、超时或异常时通过编排层中断，并在 `finally` 恢复 `enabled=false`。
5. 禁止自动重试。

审查必须完成六层交叉验证：

1. 医生需求和验收标准。
2. 算法、Mask、分母、区域定义和底层证据。
3. JSON、CSV、单位、指标与评分链路。
4. Word 文字、数值、结论和日期。
5. Word 嵌入图片及视觉表达。
6. 跨样本一致性、排序和整体表现。

问题按 P0/P1/P2 输出，包含需求 ID、样本、文件/页码/字段、实际值、期望值、证据、影响、复现方法、允许修改层级和置信度。证据缺失必须写“证据不足/阻断”。

class Config:
    """Pores V1 defaults for a 1024×1024 aligned face."""

    BLACKHAT_KERNEL_SIZES = (5, 9, 13)
    PEAK_MIN_DISTANCE = 4
    PEAK_THRESHOLD = 0.38
    MAX_FEATURES = 5000
    MIN_CENTER_RING_CONTRAST = 0.014
    MAX_PORE_RADIUS = 6
    # 只用于毛孔特征点的五官安全区，不改变底图颜色。
    FEATURE_EXCLUSION_MARGIN_PX = 30
    # 仅排除实际检测到的法令纹暗线，避免把线状阴影误认为一串圆形毛孔。
    NASOLABIAL_CORRIDOR_RADIUS_PX = 25
    NASOLABIAL_SHADOW_MARGIN_PX = 4

    HIGHLIGHT_VALUE = 0.96
    HIGHLIGHT_MAX_SATURATION = 0.22
    SHADOW_VALUE = 0.16

    FEATURE_COLOR = (145, 30, 105)
    REGION_COLOR = VISIA_BOUNDARY_COLOR

class PoresAnalyzer:
    @staticmethod
    def _pore_maps(image: np.ndarray, regions) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        mask = regions.analysis_mask
        safe_mask = cv2.erode(
            mask,
            cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE, (13, 13)),
        )
        l_channel = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2LAB)[:, :, 0]
        filled = l_channel.copy()
        valid_values = l_channel[mask > 0]
        fill_value = int(np.median(valid_values)) if valid_values.size else 128
        filled[mask == 0] = fill_value

        response_stack = get_cuda_backend().elliptical_blackhat_stack(
            filled.astype(np.float32) / 255.0,
            Config.BLACKHAT_KERNEL_SIZES,
        )
        raw = 0.70 * np.max(response_stack, axis=0) + 0.30 * np.mean(
            response_stack, axis=0
        )
        raw[safe_mask == 0] = 0.0
        robust = regional_positive_z(raw, regions, sigma_floor=0.005)
        score = robust_unit_map(robust, safe_mask, 1.0, 99.5)
        score[safe_mask == 0] = 0.0
        return score, response_stack

    @staticmethod
    def _center_ring_contrast(
        l_float: np.ndarray,
        x: int,
        y: int,
    ) -> float:
        height, width = l_float.shape
        radius = 5
        x0, x1 = max(0, x - radius), min(width, x + radius + 1)
        y0, y1 = max(0, y - radius), min(height, y + radius + 1)
        patch = l_float[y0:y1, x0:x1]
        if patch.shape[0] < 5 or patch.shape[1] < 5:
            return 0.0
        yy, xx = np.indices(patch.shape)
        cx, cy = x - x0, y - y0
        distance = np.sqrt((xx - cx) ** 2 + (yy - cy) ** 2)
        center = patch[distance <= 1.5]
        ring = patch[(distance >= 3.0) & (distance <= 5.0)]
        if center.size == 0 or ring.size == 0:
            return 0.0
        return float(np.median(ring) - np.median(center))

    @staticmethod
    def _features(
        image: np.ndarray,
        score: np.ndarray,
        response_stack: np.ndarray,
        regions,
        postprocess_exclusion: np.ndarray,
    ) -> tuple[list[dict], np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        coordinates = peak_local_max(
            score,
            min_distance=Config.PEAK_MIN_DISTANCE,
            threshold_abs=Config.PEAK_THRESHOLD,
            labels=(regions.analysis_mask > 0).astype(np.uint8),
            exclude_border=False,
            num_peaks=Config.MAX_FEATURES,
        )
        l_float = (
            cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2LAB)[:, :, 0].astype(np.float32)
            / 255.0
        )
        hsv = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV).astype(np.float32)
        saturation = hsv[:, :, 1] / 255.0
        value = hsv[:, :, 2] / 255.0
        locations: list[dict] = []
        pore_mask = np.zeros(score.shape, dtype=np.uint8)
        filtered_hair_mask = np.zeros(score.shape, dtype=np.uint8)
        kernel_radii = [(size - 1) // 2 for size in Config.BLACKHAT_KERNEL_SIZES]

        for _, (y, x) in enumerate(coordinates, 1):
            if postprocess_exclusion[y, x] > 0:
                cv2.circle(filtered_hair_mask, (int(x), int(y)), 2, 255, -1)
                continue
            if value[y, x] < Config.SHADOW_VALUE:
                continue
            if (
                value[y, x] > Config.HIGHLIGHT_VALUE
                and saturation[y, x] < Config.HIGHLIGHT_MAX_SATURATION
            ):
                continue
            contrast = PoresAnalyzer._center_ring_contrast(l_float, int(x), int(y))
            if contrast < Config.MIN_CENTER_RING_CONTRAST:
                continue
            region = assign_region(float(x), float(y), regions.regions)
            if region == "other":
                continue
            scale_index = int(np.argmax(response_stack[:, y, x]))
            radius = int(np.clip(kernel_radii[scale_index] // 2, 2, Config.MAX_PORE_RADIUS))
            value_score = float(score[y, x])
            measure_radius = max(5, radius + 2)
            y0, y1 = max(0, int(y) - measure_radius), min(score.shape[0], int(y) + measure_radius + 1)
            x0, x1 = max(0, int(x) - measure_radius), min(score.shape[1], int(x) + measure_radius + 1)
            response_patch = response_stack[scale_index, y0:y1, x0:x1]
            peak_response = float(response_stack[scale_index, y, x])
            support = (
                response_patch >= max(0.006, 0.45 * peak_response)
            ).astype(np.uint8)
            _, support_labels = cv2.connectedComponents(support, connectivity=8)
            local_label = int(support_labels[int(y) - y0, int(x) - x0])
            component = (
                (support_labels == local_label).astype(np.uint8)
                if local_label > 0 else np.zeros_like(support)
            )
            measurement_area = max(1, int(np.count_nonzero(component)))
            measurement_circularity = 0.0
            measurement_aspect = 1.0
            contours, _ = cv2.findContours(
                component * 255, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE
            )
            if contours:
                contour = max(contours, key=cv2.contourArea)
                contour_area = float(cv2.contourArea(contour))
                perimeter = float(cv2.arcLength(contour, True))
                if perimeter > 0:
                    measurement_circularity = float(np.clip(
                        4.0 * np.pi * contour_area / (perimeter * perimeter),
                        0.0, 1.0,
                    ))
                rotated_w, rotated_h = cv2.minAreaRect(contour)[1]
                if min(rotated_w, rotated_h) > 0:
                    measurement_aspect = float(
                        max(rotated_w, rotated_h) / min(rotated_w, rotated_h)
                    )
            cv2.circle(pore_mask, (int(x), int(y)), radius, 255, -1)
            locations.append(
                {
                    "id": len(locations) + 1,
                    "centroid": [int(x), int(y)],
                    "radius_px": radius,
                    "diameter_px": 2 * radius,
                    "region": region,
                    "center_ring_contrast": round(contrast, 6),
                    "pore_score": round(value_score, 5),
                    "measurement_area": measurement_area,
                    "measurement_circularity": round(measurement_circularity, 5),
                    "measurement_aspect_ratio": round(measurement_aspect, 5),
                    "confidence": round(
                        float(
                            np.clip(
                                0.35 + 0.45 * value_score + 0.20 * contrast / 0.04,
                                0,
                                1,
                            )
                        ),
                        4,
                    ),
                }
            )
        return locations, pore_mask, filtered_hair_mask

    def detect_pores(self, preprocess_result: PreprocessResultV2) -> PoresResult:
        image = np.asarray(preprocess_result.analysis_image)
        regions = build_visia_regions(
            image,
            preprocess_result.skin_mask,
            preprocess_result.landmarks,
            preprocess_result.quality_flags,
            include_chin=True,
            mode="full",
            feature_margin_px=Config.FEATURE_EXCLUSION_MARGIN_PX,
        )
        score, response_stack = self._pore_maps(image, regions)
        nasolabial_shadow = build_nasolabial_shadow_mask(
            image,
            preprocess_result.landmarks,
            regions.analysis_mask,
            radius_px=Config.NASOLABIAL_CORRIDOR_RADIUS_PX,
            output_margin_px=Config.NASOLABIAL_SHADOW_MARGIN_PX,
            restrict_frangi_to_corridor=True,
        )
        )
        moustache_exclusion = build_moustache_feature_exclusion_mask(
            image.shape[:2],
            preprocess_result.landmarks,
            regions.analysis_mask,
            margin_px=12,
        )
        postprocess_exclusion = cv2.bitwise_or(
            nasolabial_shadow,
            moustache_exclusion,
        )
        locations, pore_mask, filtered_hair_mask = self._features(
            image,
            score,
            response_stack,
            regions,
            postprocess_exclusion,
        )
        analysis_area = max(int(np.count_nonzero(regions.analysis_mask)), 1)
        area_ratio = float(np.count_nonzero(pore_mask) / analysis_area)
        distribution = {}
        for name in REGION_ORDER:
            local = [item for item in locations if item["region"] == name]
            distribution[name] = {
                "label": REGION_LABELS[name],
                "count": len(local),
            }
        scores = [item["pore_score"] for item in locations]
        diameters = [item["diameter_px"] for item in locations]

        overlay = image.copy()
        for item in locations:
            x, y = item["centroid"]
            cv2.circle(
                overlay,
                (x, y),
                max(1, min(2, int(item["radius_px"]))),
                Config.FEATURE_COLOR,
                -1,
                lineType=cv2.LINE_AA,
            )
        overlay = draw_region_boundaries(
            overlay,
            regions.display_regions,
            Config.REGION_COLOR,
            thickness=3,
            closed_contour=regions.display_contour,
            separator_contour=regions.display_separator,
        )
        result = PoresResult(
            pore_count=len(locations),
            pore_locations=locations,
            region_distribution=distribution,
            pore_area_ratio=round(area_ratio, 8),
            mean_pore_score=round(float(np.mean(scores)) if scores else 0.0, 6),
            median_pore_diameter_px=round(
                float(np.median(diameters)) if diameters else 0.0, 3
            ),
            pore_score_map=score,
            pore_mask=pore_mask,
            filtered_hair_mask=filtered_hair_mask,
            overlay=overlay,
            partial_face=regions.partial_face,
            quality_score=float(preprocess_result.quality_score),
            quality_status=str(preprocess_result.quality_status),
            quality_flags=list(preprocess_result.quality_flags),
        )
        result._medical_analysis_mask = regions.analysis_mask.copy()
        result._medical_landmarks = np.asarray(
            preprocess_result.landmarks, dtype=np.float32
        ).copy()
        result._common_debug_masks = capture_preprocess_debug(preprocess_result)
        return result

    def process_preprocess_result(
        self,
        preprocess_result: PreprocessResultV2,

"""Shared CUDA primitives for the five DermaVision analysis engines.

Only dense numeric kernels live here.  MediaPipe, connected components,
watershed, peak extraction and report generation deliberately remain on CPU.
The production default is strict CUDA: a missing GPU is an explicit error and
never changes the algorithm silently to a CPU implementation.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
import os
import threading
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

import cv2
import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F


def _truthy(value: str) -> bool:
    return value.strip().lower() not in {"0", "false", "no", "off"}


@dataclass
class GPUProfile:
    execution_profile: str
    device: str
    torch_version: str
    cuda_version: str
    gpu_name: str
    capability: tuple[int, int]
    memory_fraction: float
    kernel_seconds: float = 0.0
    calls: int = 0
    _lock: threading.Lock = field(default_factory=threading.Lock, repr=False)

    def add_timing(self, seconds: float) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self.kernel_seconds += float(seconds)
            self.calls += 1

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        return {
            "device": self.device,
            "execution_profile": self.execution_profile,
            "torch_version": self.torch_version,
            "cuda_version": self.cuda_version,
            "gpu_name": self.gpu_name,
            "compute_capability": list(self.capability),
            "memory_fraction": self.memory_fraction,
            "gpu_kernel_seconds": round(self.kernel_seconds, 6),
            "gpu_kernel_calls": self.calls,
        }


class CUDABackend:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        requested = os.getenv("DERMAVISION_DEVICE", "cuda:0").strip()
        required = _truthy(os.getenv("DERMAVISION_GPU_REQUIRED", "true"))
        if not requested.startswith("cuda"):
            if required:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "DermaVision production mode requires DERMAVISION_DEVICE=cuda:0"
                )
            raise RuntimeError("CPU backend is not provided by gpu_backend")
        if not torch.cuda.is_available():
            raise RuntimeError(
                "CUDA is required but unavailable; CPU fallback is intentionally disabled"
            )
        self.device = torch.device(requested)
        self.execution_profile = os.getenv(
            "DERMAVISION_GPU_PROFILE", "compat"
        ).strip().lower()
        if self.execution_profile not in {"compat", "fast"}:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "DERMAVISION_GPU_PROFILE must be 'compat' or 'fast'"
            )
        index = self.device.index if self.device.index is not None else 0
        torch.cuda.set_device(index)
        fraction = float(os.getenv("DERMAVISION_GPU_MEMORY_FRACTION", "0.18"))
        fraction = float(np.clip(fraction, 0.05, 0.95))
        torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(fraction, index)
        torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False
        torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True
        torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True, warn_only=True)
        self.profile = GPUProfile(
            execution_profile=self.execution_profile,
            device=str(self.device),
            torch_version=torch.__version__,
            cuda_version=str(torch.version.cuda),
            gpu_name=torch.cuda.get_device_name(index),
            capability=tuple(torch.cuda.get_device_capability(index)),
            memory_fraction=fraction,
        )
        self._kernel_cache: dict[float, torch.Tensor] = {}
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    def begin_task_profile(self) -> tuple[float, int]:
        """Start a process-local task timing window without changing results."""
        torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats(self.device)
        return self.profile.kernel_seconds, self.profile.calls

    def finish_task_profile(self, baseline: tuple[float, int]) -> dict[str, object]:
        """Return CUDA work and peak memory consumed since ``baseline``."""
        start_seconds, start_calls = baseline
        index = self.device.index if self.device.index is not None else 0
        return {
            **self.profile.as_dict(),
            "task_gpu_kernel_seconds": round(
                self.profile.kernel_seconds - float(start_seconds), 6
            ),
            "task_gpu_kernel_calls": self.profile.calls - int(start_calls),
            "task_peak_memory_mib": round(
                torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(index) / (1024.0 * 1024.0), 2
            ),
        }

    @staticmethod
    def _opencv_kernel_size(sigma: float) -> int:
        # OpenCV uses an 8-sigma support for floating point GaussianBlur when
        # ksize=(0, 0).  Keeping the same support and coefficients protects the
        # existing detection thresholds.
        return max(3, (int(round(float(sigma) * 8.0 + 1.0)) | 1))

    def _kernel_size(self, sigma: float) -> int:
        if self.execution_profile == "compat":
            return self._opencv_kernel_size(sigma)
        # Fast 候选仅缩短高斯核尾部；sigma、阈值和后处理均保持不变。
        # 6 sigma 已覆盖 99.7% 的核质量，差异通过本地对照回归验收。
        return max(3, (int(round(float(sigma) * 6.0 + 1.0)) | 1))

    def _kernel(self, sigma: float) -> torch.Tensor:
        key = float(sigma)
        with self._lock:
            cached = self._kernel_cache.get(key)
            if cached is not None:
                return cached
            size = self._kernel_size(key)
            values = cv2.getGaussianKernel(size, key, cv2.CV_32F).reshape(-1)
            kernel = torch.from_numpy(values).to(self.device).reshape(1, 1, -1)
            self._kernel_cache[key] = kernel
            return kernel

    def _gaussian(self, tensor: torch.Tensor, sigma: float) -> torch.Tensor:
        kernel = self._kernel(sigma)
        radius = kernel.shape[-1] // 2
        horizontal = kernel.reshape(1, 1, 1, -1)
        vertical = kernel.reshape(1, 1, -1, 1)

def stage5_commitment_key_id(key: bytes) -> str:
    if len(key) != 32:
        raise ValueError("Stage5 A01 commitment key must be exactly 32 raw bytes")
    return f"stage5-a01-{hashlib.sha256(key).hexdigest()[:16]}"


def build_stage5_pores_public_commitment(
    *,
    authorization: Stage5PoresRunAuthorization,
    dataset_manifest: Stage5PoresDatasetManifest,
    commitment_key: bytes,
) -> Stage5PoresPublicCommitment:
    key_id = stage5_commitment_key_id(commitment_key)
    if authorization.commitment_key_id != key_id:
        raise ValueError("authorization commitment_key_id does not match fixed key bytes")
    authorization_hmac = hmac.new(
        commitment_key,
        AUTHORIZATION_HMAC_DOMAIN + canonical_json_bytes(authorization),
        hashlib.sha256,
    ).hexdigest()
    dataset_hmac = hmac.new(
        commitment_key,
        DATASET_MANIFEST_HMAC_DOMAIN + canonical_json_bytes(dataset_manifest),
        hashlib.sha256,
    ).hexdigest()
    return Stage5PoresPublicCommitment(
        schema_version="stage5_pores_public_commitment_v1",
        dataset_id="RGB-Core13",
        authorization_id=authorization.authorization_id,
        commitment_key_id=key_id,
        authorization_hmac_sha256=authorization_hmac,
        dataset_manifest_hmac_sha256=dataset_hmac,
        coarse_counts=Stage5PublicCoarseCounts(
            sample_count=13,
            visia_sample_count=3,
            fixed_regression_sample_count=10,
            route_count=1,
            rgb_channel_count=13,
        ),
        valid_from=authorization.valid_from,
        valid_until=authorization.valid_until,
    )

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_region_state(self) -> "PoreRegionObservation":
        if self.scope_id == "overall":
            if self.label != "全面部" or self.laterality is not PoreLaterality.NONE:
                raise ValueError("overall scope requires the frozen label and NONE laterality")
        else:
            expected_label, expected_laterality = _REGION_METADATA[self.scope_id]
            if self.label != expected_label or self.laterality is not expected_laterality:
                raise ValueError("region label/laterality does not match the frozen ontology")
        metrics = (
            self.pore_count,
            self.density_per_100k_valid_skin_px,
            self.support_area_px,
            self.support_area_ratio,
            self.maximum_instance_area_px,
            self.p50_instance_area_px,
            self.p90_instance_area_px,
            self.mean_center_ring_contrast,
            self.p50_center_ring_contrast,
            self.p90_center_ring_contrast,
            self.p50_circularity,
            self.low_circularity_ratio,
            self.p50_aspect_ratio,
            self.elliptical_ratio,
            self.elongated_ratio,
            self.regular_round_ratio,
            self.high_contrast_count,
            self.high_contrast_ratio,
        )
        if self.status == "UNAVAILABLE":
            if (
                not self.reason_codes
                or self.valid_area_px is not None
                or self.valid_coverage_ratio is not None
            ):
                raise ValueError("unavailable region requires reasons and null valid geometry")
            if any(item.status is not EngineeringMetricStatus.UNAVAILABLE for item in metrics):
                raise ValueError("unavailable region requires every engineering metric to be unavailable")
            if self.large_pores.reason_code != "REGION_OR_PAIR_UNAVAILABLE":
                raise ValueError("unavailable region must prioritize region-unavailable large-pore reason")
        else:
            if (
                self.reason_codes
                or self.valid_area_px is None
                or self.valid_coverage_ratio is None
            ):
                raise ValueError("available region requires complete valid geometry")
            if self.valid_area_px < 2000 or self.valid_coverage_ratio < 0.5:
                raise ValueError("available region does not meet frozen area gates")
            expected_coverage = self.valid_area_px / self.anatomical_area_px
            if not math.isclose(self.valid_coverage_ratio, expected_coverage, abs_tol=1e-12):
                raise ValueError("valid_coverage_ratio must equal valid/anatomical area")
            for item in metrics[:4]:
                if item.status is not EngineeringMetricStatus.AVAILABLE:
                    raise ValueError("available region requires count/density/support burden metrics")
            if self.large_pores.reason_code != "LARGE_PORE_THRESHOLD_NOT_CALIBRATED":
                raise ValueError("available region must retain the uncalibrated large-pore reason")
        if len(self.reason_codes) != len(set(self.reason_codes)):
            raise ValueError("region reason_codes must be unique")
        return self

class PoreSupportFailure(ValueError):
    def __init__(self, reason_code: Stage5PoresReasonCode, detail: str) -> None:
        self.reason_code = reason_code
        super().__init__(f"{reason_code.value}: {detail}")


def _fail(
    reason_code: Stage5PoresReasonCode,
    detail: str,
) -> PoreSupportFailure:
    return PoreSupportFailure(reason_code, detail)


def _readonly_array(value: np.ndarray, *, dtype: np.dtype) -> np.ndarray:
    array = np.array(value, dtype=dtype, copy=True, order="C")
    array.setflags(write=False)
    return array


def _raw_sha256(value: np.ndarray) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(np.ascontiguousarray(value).tobytes()).hexdigest()


def _validate_binary_mask(mask: np.ndarray, *, label: str) -> np.ndarray:
    if not isinstance(mask, np.ndarray):
        raise _fail(
            Stage5PoresReasonCode.REGION_GEOMETRY_FAILED,
            f"{label} must be a NumPy array",
        )
    if mask.shape != PORE_ANALYSIS_SHAPE or mask.dtype != np.uint8:
        raise _fail(
            Stage5PoresReasonCode.REGION_GEOMETRY_FAILED,
            f"{label} must be uint8 {PORE_ANALYSIS_SHAPE}",
        )
    if not set(np.unique(mask).tolist()).issubset({0, 255}):
        raise _fail(
            Stage5PoresReasonCode.REGION_GEOMETRY_FAILED,
            f"{label} must contain only 0 and 255",
        )
    return mask > 0

docs/DOCTOR_V2_STAGE5_A01_PORES_DESIGN.md-81-- support算法版本固定为`pores_support_v1_blackhat_component_20260814`：black-hat核为`(5,9,13)`；中心处响应最大的核为实例尺度；局部窗口半径为`max(5, legacy_radius + 2)`；阈值为`max(0.006, 0.45 × centre_peak_response)`；只保留8连通且包含该中心像素的连通域。
docs/DOCTOR_V2_STAGE5_A01_PORES_DESIGN.md-82-- support入口只接受已在内存中产生的`(3,1024,1024) float32`非负finite响应栈，数值必须位于归一化黑帽响应的`[0,1]`范围；核顺序固定为`5,9,13`，中心响应完全平局时依NumPy `argmax`取最小scale index，即较小核优先。
docs/DOCTOR_V2_STAGE5_A01_PORES_DESIGN.md-83-- 旧中心快照必须是不可变tuple，stable instance ID从1开始连续且与旧中心顺序一致；x/y为`[0,1023]`中的严格Python整数，坐标不得重复。当前冻结核只能产生`legacy_radius∈{2,3}`，且必须与中心的当前scale按旧公式`clip((((kernel_size-1)//2)//2),2,6)`复算一致。任一输入违约必须`SUPPORT_INPUT_INVALID`，不得猜测修正。
docs/DOCTOR_V2_STAGE5_A01_PORES_DESIGN.md:84:- 四个公共Mask和九个valid region Mask必须是恰好`1024×1024 uint8 {0,255}`；九区互斥并且并集逐像素等于`analysis_roi ∩ valid_skin`，全面部分母不得少于500像素。这些检查在任一实例support之前执行，不允许resize或自动补区。
docs/DOCTOR_V2_STAGE5_A01_PORES_DESIGN.md-85-- 局部窗口使用裁剪到图像边界的闭区间`[center-radius, center+radius]`，以`>= threshold`生成claim；claim先与四层有效Mask相交，再用OpenCV 8连通标记选中心所在分量。中心低于0.006底线、被排除或不在中心分量时必须`INSTANCE_SUPPORT_EMPTY`，不得补1像素。
docs/DOCTOR_V2_STAGE5_A01_PORES_DESIGN.md-86-- 每个claim先与`analysis_roi_mask ∩ valid_skin_mask ∩ NOT(feature_exclusion_mask) ∩ NOT(postprocess_exclusion_mask)`相交，再重新做8连通中心分量选择；中心分量为空时Stage5硬失败为`INSTANCE_SUPPORT_EMPTY`，不得删掉实例后继续。
docs/DOCTOR_V2_STAGE5_A01_PORES_DESIGN.md-87-- 重叠仲裁只在“声明该像素”的候选实例之间执行：按像素中心到候选中心的平方距离唯一归属；距离完全相同时由较小稳定实例ID优先。label 0固定表示无证据，实例ID从1连续递增且必须与旧中心顺序一一对应。
docs/DOCTOR_V2_STAGE5_A01_PORES_DESIGN.md:88:- 跨九区support采用“按像素拆分”规则：实例仍按中心归属一个区域，实例面积/圆度/长宽比使用其完整唯一label；分区support面积按像素所在九区统计。输出`boundary_crossing_instance_count`，并机械验证九区support面积之和等于全面部support面积。
docs/DOCTOR_V2_STAGE5_A01_PORES_DESIGN.md-89-- Stage5实例面积、圆度和长宽比从最终唯一label map复算；总面积使用label map并集，不再把实例面积简单相加。

+    return mask > 0
+
+
+def _validate_region_keys(
+    masks: Mapping[PoreRegionId, np.ndarray],
+    *,
+    label: str,
+) -> None:
+    if not isinstance(masks, Mapping) or set(masks) != set(PoreRegionId):
+        raise _fail(
+            Stage5PoresReasonCode.REGION_ONTOLOGY_INCOMPLETE,
+            f"{label} must contain every frozen pore region exactly once",
+        )
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PoreValidRegionSetV1:
+    valid_denominator_mask: np.ndarray
+    valid_region_masks: Mapping[PoreRegionId, np.ndarray]
+    anatomical_area_px: Mapping[PoreRegionId, int]
+    valid_area_px: Mapping[PoreRegionId, int]
+    valid_coverage_ratio: Mapping[PoreRegionId, float]
+    anatomical_union_area_px: int
+    valid_denominator_area_px: int
+    valid_denominator_raw_sha256: str
+    valid_region_raw_sha256: Mapping[PoreRegionId, str]
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class LegacyPoreMetricSnapshotV1:
+    stable_instance_id: int
+    center_ring_contrast: float
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PoreInstanceEvidenceV1:
+    stable_instance_id: int
+    center_region_id: PoreRegionId
+    center_ring_contrast: float
+    final_area_px: int
+    circularity: float
+    aspect_ratio: float

+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PoreMetricsResultV1:
+    algorithm_version: str
+    engineering_threshold_version: str
+    valid_regions: PoreValidRegionSetV1
+    instance_evidence: tuple[PoreInstanceEvidenceV1, ...]
+    overall: PoreRegionObservation
+    regions: tuple[PoreRegionObservation, ...]
+    bilateral_comparisons: tuple[PoreBilateralComparison, ...]
+    modalities: tuple[PoreModalityObservation, ...]
+    boundary_crossing_instance_count: int
+
+
+def build_pore_valid_regions_v1(
+    *,
+    anatomical_region_masks: Mapping[PoreRegionId, np.ndarray],
+    analysis_roi_mask: np.ndarray,
+    valid_skin_mask: np.ndarray,
+) -> PoreValidRegionSetV1:
+    """Build the frozen nine-region denominator without repairing geometry."""
+
+    _validate_region_keys(anatomical_region_masks, label="anatomical region masks")
+    analysis_roi = _validate_binary_mask(analysis_roi_mask, label="analysis_roi_mask")
+    valid_skin = _validate_binary_mask(valid_skin_mask, label="valid_skin_mask")
+
+    anatomical_bools: dict[PoreRegionId, np.ndarray] = {}
+    occupancy = np.zeros(PORE_ANALYSIS_SHAPE, dtype=np.uint8)
+    anatomical_area: dict[PoreRegionId, int] = {}
+    for region_id in PoreRegionId:
+        region = _validate_binary_mask(
+            anatomical_region_masks[region_id],
+            label=f"anatomical_region_masks[{region_id.value}]",
+        )
+        area = int(np.count_nonzero(region))
+        if area == 0:
+            raise _fail(
+                Stage5PoresReasonCode.REGION_GEOMETRY_FAILED,
+                f"anatomical region {region_id.value} is empty",
+            )
+        occupancy += region.astype(np.uint8)
+        anatomical_bools[region_id] = region
+        anatomical_area[region_id] = area
+    if np.any(occupancy > 1):
+        raise _fail(
+            Stage5PoresReasonCode.REGION_ONTOLOGY_INCOMPLETE,
+            "anatomical regions overlap",
+        )
+
+    anatomical_union = occupancy == 1
+    valid_denominator = analysis_roi & valid_skin
+    denominator_area = int(np.count_nonzero(valid_denominator))
+    if denominator_area < PORE_MIN_DENOMINATOR_AREA_PX:
+        raise _fail(
+            Stage5PoresReasonCode.REGION_GEOMETRY_FAILED,
+            "valid denominator is smaller than the frozen 500-pixel hard gate",
+        )
+    if np.any(valid_denominator & ~anatomical_union):
+        raise _fail(
+            Stage5PoresReasonCode.REGION_ONTOLOGY_INCOMPLETE,
+            "analysis denominator escapes the anatomical nine-region union",
+        )
+
+    valid_masks: dict[PoreRegionId, np.ndarray] = {}
+    valid_area: dict[PoreRegionId, int] = {}
+    valid_coverage: dict[PoreRegionId, float] = {}
+    valid_hashes: dict[PoreRegionId, str] = {}
+    rebuilt_union = np.zeros(PORE_ANALYSIS_SHAPE, dtype=bool)
+    for region_id in PoreRegionId:
+        region = anatomical_bools[region_id] & valid_denominator
+        rebuilt_union |= region
+        encoded = _readonly_array(region.astype(np.uint8) * 255, dtype=np.uint8)
+        area = int(np.count_nonzero(region))
+        valid_masks[region_id] = encoded
+        valid_area[region_id] = area
+        valid_coverage[region_id] = float(area / anatomical_area[region_id])
+        valid_hashes[region_id] = _raw_sha256(encoded)
+    if not np.array_equal(rebuilt_union, valid_denominator):
+        raise _fail(
+            Stage5PoresReasonCode.REGION_ONTOLOGY_INCOMPLETE,
+            "valid regions do not add back exactly to the analysis denominator",
+        )
+
+    encoded_denominator = _readonly_array(
+        valid_denominator.astype(np.uint8) * 255,
+        dtype=np.uint8,
+    )
+    return PoreValidRegionSetV1(
+        valid_denominator_mask=encoded_denominator,
+        valid_region_masks=MappingProxyType(valid_masks),
+        anatomical_area_px=MappingProxyType(anatomical_area),
+        valid_area_px=MappingProxyType(valid_area),
+        valid_coverage_ratio=MappingProxyType(valid_coverage),
+        anatomical_union_area_px=int(np.count_nonzero(anatomical_union)),
+        valid_denominator_area_px=denominator_area,
+        valid_denominator_raw_sha256=_raw_sha256(encoded_denominator),
+        valid_region_raw_sha256=MappingProxyType(valid_hashes),
+    )
+
+
+def _validate_support_result(result: PoreSupportResultV1) -> None:
+    if not isinstance(result, PoreSupportResultV1):
+        raise _fail(
+            Stage5PoresReasonCode.SUPPORT_INPUT_INVALID,
+            "support_result must be PoreSupportResultV1",
+        )
+    if result.algorithm_version != PORE_SUPPORT_ALGORITHM_VERSION:
+        raise _fail(
+            Stage5PoresReasonCode.SUPPORT_INPUT_INVALID,
+            "support_result algorithm version drifted",
+        )
+    binary_arrays = (
+        ("valid_denominator_mask", result.valid_denominator_mask),
+        ("valid_claim_mask", result.valid_claim_mask),
+        ("evidence_support_mask", result.evidence_support_mask),
+    )
+    for label, array in binary_arrays:
+        _validate_binary_mask(array, label=label)
+        if not array.flags.c_contiguous or array.flags.writeable:
+            raise _fail(
+                Stage5PoresReasonCode.SUPPORT_INPUT_INVALID,
+                f"{label} must be C-contiguous and read-only",
+            )
+    label_map = result.instance_label_map
+    if (
+        not isinstance(label_map, np.ndarray)
+        or label_map.shape != PORE_ANALYSIS_SHAPE
+        or label_map.dtype != np.dtype("<u4")
+        or not label_map.flags.c_contiguous
+        or label_map.flags.writeable
+    ):
+        raise _fail(
+            Stage5PoresReasonCode.LABEL_SUPPORT_INCONSISTENT,
+            "instance_label_map must be read-only C-contiguous little-endian uint32",
+        )
+    if not np.array_equal(result.evidence_support_mask > 0, label_map > 0):
+        raise _fail(
+            Stage5PoresReasonCode.LABEL_SUPPORT_INCONSISTENT,
+            "support and label occupancy disagree",
+        )
+    if np.any((result.evidence_support_mask > 0) & ~(result.valid_claim_mask > 0)):
+        raise _fail(
+            Stage5PoresReasonCode.SUPPORT_SUBSET_VIOLATION,
+            "support escapes the valid claim",
+        )
+    if np.any((result.valid_claim_mask > 0) & ~(result.valid_denominator_mask > 0)):
+        raise _fail(
+            Stage5PoresReasonCode.SUPPORT_SUBSET_VIOLATION,
+            "valid claim escapes the valid denominator",
+        )
+    hashes = (
+        (result.valid_denominator_mask, result.valid_denominator_raw_sha256),
+        (result.valid_claim_mask, result.valid_claim_raw_sha256),
+        (result.evidence_support_mask, result.evidence_support_raw_sha256),
+        (label_map, result.instance_label_raw_sha256),
+    )
+    if any(_raw_sha256(array) != expected for array, expected in hashes):
+        raise _fail(
+            Stage5PoresReasonCode.ARTIFACT_HASH_MISMATCH,
+            "support_result raw array hash mismatch",
+        )
+    if not isinstance(result.instances, tuple):
+        raise _fail(
+            Stage5PoresReasonCode.SUPPORT_INPUT_INVALID,
+            "support instances must be an immutable tuple",
+        )
+    expected_ids = tuple(range(1, len(result.instances) + 1))
+    actual_ids = tuple(item.stable_instance_id for item in result.instances)
+    label_ids = tuple(int(value) for value in np.unique(label_map) if int(value) != 0)
+    if actual_ids != expected_ids or label_ids != expected_ids:
+        raise _fail(
+            Stage5PoresReasonCode.LABEL_SUPPORT_INCONSISTENT,
+            "support instances and label IDs must be the same continuous set",
+        )
+    for instance in result.instances:
+        if not isinstance(instance, PoreInstanceSupportV1):
+            raise _fail(
+                Stage5PoresReasonCode.SUPPORT_INPUT_INVALID,
+                "support instance has the wrong type",
+            )
+        if not (
+            0 <= instance.center_x < PORE_ANALYSIS_SHAPE[1]
+            and 0 <= instance.center_y < PORE_ANALYSIS_SHAPE[0]
+            and int(label_map[instance.center_y, instance.center_x])
+            == instance.stable_instance_id
+        ):
+            raise _fail(
+                Stage5PoresReasonCode.LABEL_SUPPORT_INCONSISTENT,
+                f"instance {instance.stable_instance_id} lost its valid center",
+            )
+        actual_area = int(np.count_nonzero(label_map == instance.stable_instance_id))
+        if actual_area != instance.final_area_px or actual_area <= 0:
+            raise _fail(
+                Stage5PoresReasonCode.LABEL_SUPPORT_INCONSISTENT,
+                f"instance {instance.stable_instance_id} area drifted",
+            )
+        if not (
+            math.isfinite(instance.circularity)
+            and 0 <= instance.circularity <= 1
+            and math.isfinite(instance.aspect_ratio)
+            and instance.aspect_ratio >= 1
+        ):
+            raise _fail(
+                Stage5PoresReasonCode.LABEL_SUPPORT_INCONSISTENT,
+                f"instance {instance.stable_instance_id} morphology is invalid",
+            )
+    if set(result.region_support_area_px) != set(PoreRegionId):
+        raise _fail(
+            Stage5PoresReasonCode.REGION_ONTOLOGY_INCOMPLETE,
+            "support result lacks the frozen region support keys",
+        )
+    if (
+        sum(result.region_support_area_px.values())
+        != int(np.count_nonzero(result.evidence_support_mask))
+    ):
+        raise _fail(
+            Stage5PoresReasonCode.REGION_ONTOLOGY_INCOMPLETE,
+            "support result regional areas do not add back",
+        )
+    if result.boundary_crossing_instance_count != sum(
+        item.boundary_crossing for item in result.instances
+    ):
+        raise _fail(
+            Stage5PoresReasonCode.LABEL_SUPPORT_INCONSISTENT,
+            "boundary crossing count drifted from instances",
+        )
+
+
+def _validate_metric_snapshots(
+    snapshots: tuple[LegacyPoreMetricSnapshotV1, ...],
+    *,
+    expected_count: int,
+) -> Mapping[int, LegacyPoreMetricSnapshotV1]:
+    if not isinstance(snapshots, tuple) or len(snapshots) != expected_count:
+        raise _fail(
+            Stage5PoresReasonCode.SUPPORT_INPUT_INVALID,
+            "legacy metric snapshots must be an exact immutable tuple for every instance",
+        )
+    indexed: dict[int, LegacyPoreMetricSnapshotV1] = {}
+    for expected_id, snapshot in enumerate(snapshots, start=1):
+        if not isinstance(snapshot, LegacyPoreMetricSnapshotV1):
+            raise _fail(
+                Stage5PoresReasonCode.SUPPORT_INPUT_INVALID,
+                "legacy metric snapshot has the wrong type",
+            )
+        if type(snapshot.stable_instance_id) is not int or snapshot.stable_instance_id != expected_id:
+            raise _fail(
+                Stage5PoresReasonCode.SUPPORT_INPUT_INVALID,
+                "legacy metric snapshot IDs must be continuous and ordered",
+            )
+        contrast = snapshot.center_ring_contrast
+        if (
+            type(contrast) is not float
+            or not math.isfinite(contrast)
+            or not PORE_LEGACY_MIN_CENTER_RING_CONTRAST <= contrast <= 1.0
+        ):
+            raise _fail(
+                Stage5PoresReasonCode.SUPPORT_INPUT_INVALID,
+                "center-ring contrast must remain a finite accepted old-chain float",
+            )
+        indexed[expected_id] = snapshot
+    return MappingProxyType(indexed)
+
+
+def _available_metric(
+    value: int | float,
+    unit: str,
+    reasons: tuple[Stage5PoresReasonCode, ...] = (),
+) -> EngineeringMetric:
+    return EngineeringMetric(
+        status=EngineeringMetricStatus.AVAILABLE,
+        value=value,
+        unit=unit,
+        reason_codes=reasons,
+    )
+
+
+def _unavailable_metric(
+    unit: str,
+    reasons: tuple[Stage5PoresReasonCode, ...],
+) -> EngineeringMetric:
+    return EngineeringMetric(
+        status=EngineeringMetricStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
+        value=None,
+        unit=unit,
+        reason_codes=reasons,
+    )
+
+
+def _large_pore_null(*, scope_available: bool) -> LargePoreNullMetrics:
+    return LargePoreNullMetrics(
+        definition_status="UNAVAILABLE",
+        count=None,
+        ratio=None,
+        area_px=None,
+        area_ratio=None,
+        reason_code=(
+            "LARGE_PORE_THRESHOLD_NOT_CALIBRATED"
+            if scope_available
+            else "REGION_OR_PAIR_UNAVAILABLE"
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def _percentile(values: tuple[float, ...], percentile: float) -> float:
+    return float(
+        np.percentile(
+            np.asarray(values, dtype=np.float64),
+            percentile,
+            method="linear",
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def _stability_status(count: int) -> PoreInstanceStabilityStatus:
+    if count == 0:
+        return PoreInstanceStabilityStatus.NO_INSTANCES
+    if count < 5:
+        return PoreInstanceStabilityStatus.VERY_LOW_N_LT_5
+    if count < 10:
+        return PoreInstanceStabilityStatus.LOW_N_5_TO_9
+    if count < 20:
+        return PoreInstanceStabilityStatus.LOW_STABILITY_N_LT_20
+    return PoreInstanceStabilityStatus.STABLE_N_GE_20
+
+
+def _unavailable_scope_metrics(
+    *,
+    scope_id: str | PoreRegionId,
+    label: str,
+    laterality: PoreLaterality,
+    anatomical_area_px: int,
+    reasons: tuple[Stage5PoresReasonCode, ...],
+) -> PoreRegionObservation:
+    unavailable_count = _unavailable_metric("count", reasons)
+    unavailable_density = _unavailable_metric("count_per_100k_valid_skin_px", reasons)
+    unavailable_px = _unavailable_metric("px", reasons)
+    unavailable_ratio = _unavailable_metric("ratio", reasons)
+    unavailable_contrast = _unavailable_metric("normalized_luminance_difference_0_1", reasons)
+    return PoreRegionObservation(
+        scope_id=scope_id,
+        label=label,
+        laterality=laterality,
+        status="UNAVAILABLE",
+        reason_codes=reasons,
+        anatomical_area_px=anatomical_area_px,
+        valid_area_px=None,
+        valid_coverage_ratio=None,
+        instance_count_stability_status=PoreInstanceStabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
+        pore_count=unavailable_count,
+        density_per_100k_valid_skin_px=unavailable_density,
+        support_area_px=unavailable_px,
+        support_area_ratio=unavailable_ratio,
+        maximum_instance_area_px=unavailable_px,
+        p50_instance_area_px=unavailable_px,
+        p90_instance_area_px=unavailable_px,
+        mean_center_ring_contrast=unavailable_contrast,
+        p50_center_ring_contrast=unavailable_contrast,
+        p90_center_ring_contrast=unavailable_contrast,
+        p50_circularity=unavailable_ratio,
+        low_circularity_ratio=unavailable_ratio,
+        p50_aspect_ratio=_unavailable_metric("aspect_ratio", reasons),
+        elliptical_ratio=unavailable_ratio,
+        elongated_ratio=unavailable_ratio,
+        regular_round_ratio=_unavailable_metric(
+            "ratio",
+            (Stage5PoresReasonCode.REGION_OR_PAIR_UNAVAILABLE,),
+        ),
+        high_contrast_count=_unavailable_metric(
+            "count",
+            (Stage5PoresReasonCode.REGION_OR_PAIR_UNAVAILABLE,),
+        ),
+        high_contrast_ratio=_unavailable_metric(
+            "ratio",
+            (Stage5PoresReasonCode.REGION_OR_PAIR_UNAVAILABLE,),
+        ),
+        large_pores=_large_pore_null(scope_available=False),
+    )
+
+
+def _build_scope_observation(
+    *,
+    scope_id: str | PoreRegionId,
+    label: str,
+    laterality: PoreLaterality,
+    anatomical_area_px: int,
+    valid_area_px: int,
+    support_area_px: int,
+    instances: tuple[PoreInstanceEvidenceV1, ...],
+) -> PoreRegionObservation:
+    coverage = float(valid_area_px / anatomical_area_px)
+    unavailable_reasons: list[Stage5PoresReasonCode] = []
+    if valid_area_px < PORE_REGION_MIN_VALID_AREA_PX:
+        unavailable_reasons.append(Stage5PoresReasonCode.REGION_AREA_LT_2000)
+    if coverage < PORE_REGION_MIN_COVERAGE_RATIO:
+        unavailable_reasons.append(Stage5PoresReasonCode.REGION_COVERAGE_LT_0_5)
+    if unavailable_reasons:
+        return _unavailable_scope_metrics(
+            scope_id=scope_id,
+            label=label,
+            laterality=laterality,
+            anatomical_area_px=anatomical_area_px,
+            reasons=tuple(unavailable_reasons),
+        )
+
+    count = len(instances)
+    burden_reasons = (
+        (Stage5PoresReasonCode.LOW_STABILITY_N_LT_20,)
+        if 10 <= count < 20
+        else ()
+    )
+    areas = tuple(float(item.final_area_px) for item in instances)
+    contrasts = tuple(item.center_ring_contrast for item in instances)
+    circularities = tuple(item.circularity for item in instances)
+    aspects = tuple(item.aspect_ratio for item in instances)
+
+    maximum_area = (
+        _available_metric(int(max(areas)), "px")
+        if count >= 1
+        else _unavailable_metric("px", (Stage5PoresReasonCode.NO_INSTANCES,))
+    )
+    p50_area = (
+        _available_metric(_percentile(areas, 50), "px")
+        if count >= 5
+        else _unavailable_metric("px", (Stage5PoresReasonCode.INSTANCE_COUNT_LT_5,))
+    )
+    p90_area = (
+        _available_metric(_percentile(areas, 90), "px", burden_reasons)
+        if count >= 10
+        else _unavailable_metric("px", (Stage5PoresReasonCode.INSTANCE_COUNT_LT_10,))
+    )
+    mean_contrast = (
+        _available_metric(
+            float(np.mean(np.asarray(contrasts, dtype=np.float64))),
+            "normalized_luminance_difference_0_1",
+        )
+        if count >= 5
+        else _unavailable_metric(
+            "normalized_luminance_difference_0_1",
+            (Stage5PoresReasonCode.INSTANCE_COUNT_LT_5,),
+        )
+    )
+    p50_contrast = (
+        _available_metric(
+            _percentile(contrasts, 50),
+            "normalized_luminance_difference_0_1",
+        )
+        if count >= 5
+        else _unavailable_metric(
+            "normalized_luminance_difference_0_1",
+            (Stage5PoresReasonCode.INSTANCE_COUNT_LT_5,),
+        )
+    )
+    p90_contrast = (
+        _available_metric(
+            _percentile(contrasts, 90),
+            "normalized_luminance_difference_0_1",
+            burden_reasons,
+        )
+        if count >= 10
+        else _unavailable_metric(
+            "normalized_luminance_difference_0_1",
+            (Stage5PoresReasonCode.INSTANCE_COUNT_LT_10,),
+        )
+    )
+    if count >= 10:
+        p50_circularity = _available_metric(
+            _percentile(circularities, 50),
+            "ratio",
+            burden_reasons,
+        )
+        low_circularity = _available_metric(
+            float(
+                sum(value < PORE_LOW_CIRCULARITY_THRESHOLD for value in circularities)
+                / count
+            ),
+            "ratio",
+            burden_reasons,
+        )
+        p50_aspect = _available_metric(
+            _percentile(aspects, 50),
+            "aspect_ratio",
+            burden_reasons,
+        )
+        elliptical = _available_metric(
+            float(
+                sum(value >= PORE_ELLIPTICAL_ASPECT_RATIO_THRESHOLD for value in aspects)
+                / count
+            ),
+            "ratio",
+            burden_reasons,
+        )
+        elongated = _available_metric(
+            float(
+                sum(value >= PORE_ELONGATED_ASPECT_RATIO_THRESHOLD for value in aspects)
+                / count
+            ),
+            "ratio",
+            burden_reasons,
+        )
+    else:
+        low_n = (Stage5PoresReasonCode.INSTANCE_COUNT_LT_10,)
+        p50_circularity = _unavailable_metric("ratio", low_n)
+        low_circularity = _unavailable_metric("ratio", low_n)
+        p50_aspect = _unavailable_metric("aspect_ratio", low_n)
+        elliptical = _unavailable_metric("ratio", low_n)
+        elongated = _unavailable_metric("ratio", low_n)
+
+    return PoreRegionObservation(
+        scope_id=scope_id,
+        label=label,
+        laterality=laterality,
+        status="AVAILABLE",
+        reason_codes=(),
+        anatomical_area_px=anatomical_area_px,
+        valid_area_px=valid_area_px,
+        valid_coverage_ratio=coverage,
+        instance_count_stability_status=_stability_status(count),
+        pore_count=_available_metric(count, "count", burden_reasons),
+        density_per_100k_valid_skin_px=_available_metric(
+            float(count * PORE_DENSITY_SCALE / valid_area_px),
+            "count_per_100k_valid_skin_px",
+            burden_reasons,
+        ),
+        support_area_px=_available_metric(support_area_px, "px", burden_reasons),
+        support_area_ratio=_available_metric(
+            float(support_area_px / valid_area_px),
+            "ratio",
+            burden_reasons,
+        ),
+        maximum_instance_area_px=maximum_area,
+        p50_instance_area_px=p50_area,
+        p90_instance_area_px=p90_area,
+        mean_center_ring_contrast=mean_contrast,
+        p50_center_ring_contrast=p50_contrast,
+        p90_center_ring_contrast=p90_contrast,
+        p50_circularity=p50_circularity,
+        low_circularity_ratio=low_circularity,
+        p50_aspect_ratio=p50_aspect,
+        elliptical_ratio=elliptical,
+        elongated_ratio=elongated,
+        regular_round_ratio=_unavailable_metric(
+            "ratio",
+            (Stage5PoresReasonCode.ROUND_SHAPE_THRESHOLD_NOT_CALIBRATED,),
+        ),
+        high_contrast_count=_unavailable_metric(
+            "count",
+            (Stage5PoresReasonCode.HIGH_CONTRAST_THRESHOLD_NOT_CALIBRATED,),
+        ),
+        high_contrast_ratio=_unavailable_metric(
+            "ratio",

def _junit_summary(path: Path, *, require_clean: bool) -> dict[str, Any]:
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    root = ET.fromstring(raw)
    suite = root[0] if root.tag == "testsuites" else root
    summary: dict[str, Any] = {
        key: int(suite.attrib.get(key, "0"))
        for key in ("tests", "failures", "errors", "skipped")
    }
    cases = root.findall(".//testcase")
    failed_cases = [
        {
            "classname": case.attrib.get("classname", ""),
            "name": case.attrib.get("name", ""),
            "message": failure.attrib.get("message", ""),
        }
        for case in cases
        for failure in case.findall("failure")
    ]
    summary["serialized_testcase_nodes"] = len(cases)
    summary["subtest_delta"] = summary["tests"] - len(cases)
    summary["failed_cases"] = failed_cases
    summary["sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    if summary["subtest_delta"] < 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"JUnit count is inconsistent: {path}")
    if require_clean and any(
        summary[key] != 0 for key in ("failures", "errors", "skipped")
    ):
        raise RuntimeError(f"clean JUnit contains a failure: {path}: {summary}")
    return summary

+
+1. 直接构造或`dataclasses.replace`伪造anatomical面积、覆盖率、Mask hash、support morphology和support metadata时，聚合入口是否都能fail-closed；还有哪些被使用却不能从现有输入复算的字段。

+7. 27项metrics、31项support、17项geometry、19项authority、71项Stage2、15项Stage3、20项Stage4和Worker 43 serialized+522 subtests的clean JUnit是否均真实为0 failure/error/skip，且schema/diff/compile边界一致。

## 信封格式（worker 返回）

dermavision worker 的 `analyze_image` 任务必须返回统一信封格式。信封包含 5 个字段：

| 字段 | 类型 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| `record_id` | str | 任务追踪 ID，同时用作 OSS 结果路径组件。后端 AlgorithmEnvelope 接受此字段但不参与核心校验 |
| `status` | str | 任务状态：`"success"` / `"failed"`。后端 `_check_group` 检查此字段，failed 会直接报错 |
| `meta_data` | dict | 算法元数据：`{"name": <算法名>, "version": "1"}`。version 写死 `"1"`，对应后端 AlgorithmRegistry 注册的 v1 实现器 |
| `raw_result` | dict | 算法原始结果（OSS key 形式的图片路径 + 量化指标 + 质量信息）。后端读取时调 `to_response` 转换为前端格式 |
| `debug_info` | dict | 调试信息（CSV 报告路径、计时、执行模式）。不直接给前端，由 `to_response` 提取需要的字段 |

### 信封结构示例

```json
{
  "record_id": "6a61770e3423989c53a05d63",
  "status": "success",
  "meta_data": {
    "name": "redness",
    "version": "1"
  },
  "raw_result": {
    "overlay": "dermavision/v1/6a61770e.../03_RBX红区结果图.jpg",
    "metrics": { ... },
    "quality_score": 74.89,
    "quality_status": "WARNING",
    "quality_flags": ["low_contrast"]
  },
  "debug_info": {
    "report_csv": "dermavision/v1/6a61770e.../redness_report.csv",
    "timing_seconds": { "download": 0.5, "pipeline": 3.2, "upload": 0.3 },
    "execution_mode": "single_algorithm"
  }
}
```

### raw_result 字段（各算法差异）

| 算法 | 共有字段 | 特有字段 |
|------|----------|----------|
| redness | overlay, metrics, quality_score, quality_status, quality_flags | red_areas_overlay |
| spots | overlay, metrics, quality_score, quality_status, quality_flags | - |
| brown | overlay, metrics, quality_score, quality_status, quality_flags | brown_spots_overlay |
| texture | overlay, metrics, quality_score, quality_status, quality_flags | - |
| pores | overlay, metrics, quality_score, quality_status, quality_flags | - |
| purple | metrics, quality_score, quality_status, quality_flags | uv_base, uv_spots_overlay, fluorescence_base, porphyrin_overlay |

- `overlay`: OSS key（结果图），后端 `to_response` 转预签名 URL
- `metrics`: 量化指标 dict，redness/spots 为完整英文 dict 透传，brown/texture/pores 为精简中文 dict
- `quality_score`/`quality_status`/`quality_flags`: 图片质量信息
- `purple` 为独立新增算法，正式返回四张图：UV底图、UV色斑实例图、
  荧光UV底图和紫质实例图；现有五项字段保持不变。

### version 写死 "1"

`meta_data.version` 写死 `"1"`，不再从环境变量 `settings.algorithm_version` 读取。后端 AlgorithmRegistry 按 `(name, "1")` 注册 v1 实现器，version 不匹配会导致 `get_version` 找不到、回退 v0（旧格式透传）。

### 多算法兼容模式

`_build_envelope_response` 仅用于单算法任务（`len(algorithms) == 1 and algorithms[0] in _ENVELOPE_ALGOS`）。多算法兼容模式（理论上不会走到）返回旧格式，后端 `validate_worker_result` 会报错。

### 失败返回

失败时返回 `{"record_id": ..., "status": "failed", "error_message": "..."}`，后端 `_check_group` 检查 status 后直接报错，不走 `validate_worker_result`。

---

## 部署注意

dermavision 与 ai-skin-backend 需要同时部署。版本不匹配会导致：
- worker 返回旧格式 -> ai-skin-backend `validate_worker_result` 报错（pydantic `extra="forbid"`）
- ai-skin-backend 未更新 -> 读取返回空数据（`to_response` 从 `raw_result` 取字段，旧数据没有 `raw_result`）

docs/DOCTOR_V2_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md:9:阶段4只把上述工程状态投影到“身份匿名的结构状态包”，并冻结未来证据的1024坐标、Mask包含关系和score-map元数据合同。阶段4没有运行任何head：每行历史能力仍可显示为baseline，但本次运行的十一维统一为`NOT_ASSESSABLE + NOT_REPORTABLE + UNAVAILABLE`，分数/等级/建议均为空。因此阶段4同样不改变下表任何一行的医学完成度，完整医学闭环仍为`0/11`。
docs/DOCTOR_V2_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md:11:阶段4已由唯一强审查代理在R7完成30/30项终审，工程、来源隐私、资源和review manifest门通过，因此允许工程收口并进入Stage5 A波。该结论不改变`0/11`：正式报告和视觉门仍为`BLOCKED`，也没有授予任何模块`MEDICAL_READY`或`CLINICAL_ELIGIBLE`。

| 10 | 光滑度由隆起、凹陷、附着物三类不平整构成，医生 V2 要求照片与 3D 的高度/深度/体积证据 | texture 仅为二维可见表面纹理 proxy | `SurfaceIrregularityAppearance2D` 仅二维补充；PP 可增强表面观察，不能补足 3D | `PARTIAL` | `INTERNAL_ONLY` | 永久标记 `insufficient_for_full_v2`；不能把 texture 改名为光滑度；未接入合格 3D 前不得输出正式光滑度分数或等级 |
| 11 | 中面部支撑、结构性沟槽、下脸松垂，核心要求曲面、深度、体积和轮廓几何 | 正面 2D 仅可提供 `FrontContourAppearance2D` | 完整构念需侧面、多角度、深度或 3D | `NOT_ASSESSABLE` | `NOT_REPORTABLE` | 正式模块固定不可评估；二维补充不得输出紧致度分数、护理建议或病因解释 |

## 模态使用冻结

| 通道 | 允许用途 | 禁止用途 |
|---|---|---|
| RGB | consumer 主输入；clinic 的硬必需锚点；可见外观证据 | 冒充 CP、365、深度或 3D |
| PP | 表面纹理、细纹、毛孔和反射候选的增强对照 | 产生第二套评分；在 RGB 失败时单独继续整次运行 |
| CP | 色素、泛红和血管候选的仪器主证据 | 缺失时用 RGB 伪造 clinic 主证据 |
| 365 | 在物理属性签署后用于 UV/荧光/紫质证据 | 未确认成像物理属性时直接称紫质或油脂；缺失时写 0 |

## 分波顺序

- A 波：01 毛孔、03 综合色素、05 血管、07 干纹。
- B 波：06 痤疮、04 弥漫性泛红、02 油光。
- C 波：08、09 仅二维补充。
- D 波：10 二维表面不规则；11 维持不可评估并只提供二维补充。

每个模块必须依次通过单样本工程证据、Core13/Clinic 横向工程门、报告门和强审查；医生双标、仲裁及正式统计完成前不得标记 `MEDICAL_READY`。

## 01 毛孔九分区本体冻结
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import shutil
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

from docx import Document

from src.aisia_medical_report import generate_dual_reports_from_review_result
from src.scoring_calibration.v011.registry import REGISTRY
from src.scoring_calibration.v011.scoring import transform_value


def _features(value: float = 2.0) -> dict:
    root: dict = {}
    for dimension in REGISTRY:
        for group in dimension.groups:
            for metric in group.metrics:
                node = root
                parts = metric.source.split(".")
                for part in parts[:-1]:
                    node = node.setdefault(part, {})
                node[parts[-1]] = value
    return root


def _profile(path: Path) -> None:
    references = {}
    for dimension in REGISTRY:
        for group in dimension.groups:
            for metric in group.metrics:
                references[metric.id] = [transform_value(float(value), metric.transform) for value in range(1, 1002)]
    path.write_text(json.dumps({
        "scoring_profile_version": "aisia_scoring_v0.1.1_integrity_test_20260806",
        "profile_ready": True,
        "status": "candidate/uncalibrated",
        "algorithm_version": "test-algorithm",
        "metrics_schema_version": "scoring_features_v1",
        "reference_sample_counts": {"PASS": 1001},
        "references": references,
    }, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")


def _result(root: Path) -> None:
    root.mkdir()
    source = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "data" / "test_images" / "visia示例图2.png"
    shutil.copy2(source, root / "00_输入图片.png")
    names = ("redness", "spots", "brown", "texture", "pores", "uv_spots", "porphyrin", "wrinkle", "acne")
    (root / "九项检测结果索引.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "状态": "success", "成功项目数": 9, "项目总数": 9,
        "九项结果": {name: {"状态": "success"} for name in names},
    }, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    features = _features()
    (root / "九项核心量化指标.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "九项": {name: {"评分输入": features.get(name, {})} for name in names}
    }, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")


def _all_text(path: Path) -> str:
    doc = Document(path)
    parts = [paragraph.text for paragraph in doc.paragraphs]
    for table in doc.tables:
        parts.extend(cell.text for row in table.rows for cell in row.cells)
    return "\n".join(parts)


def test_dual_reports_share_scores_and_have_real_navigation(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    result = tmp_path / "sample"
    _result(result)
    profile = tmp_path / "profile.json"
    _profile(profile)
    output = generate_dual_reports_from_review_result(result, profile, report_id="DUAL-TEST")
    assert output["json"] == output["structured_json"]
    assert output["docx"] == output["doctor_docx"]
    for key in ("user_docx", "doctor_docx", "structured_json", "scoring_trace_json"):
        assert Path(output[key]).is_file()

    payload = json.loads(Path(output["structured_json"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    trace = json.loads(Path(output["scoring_trace_json"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    scored = [module for module in payload["检测模块"] if isinstance(module.get("综合得分"), (int, float))]
    assert len(scored) == 3
    assert len(trace["formal_dimension_scores"]) == 4
    assert payload["报告信息"]["综合得分"] is None
    modules = {row["模块编号"]: row for row in payload["检测模块"]}
    assert modules["10"]["综合得分"] is None
    assert modules["10"]["证据名称"] == "SurfaceIrregularityAppearance2D"
    assert modules["10"]["医学构念满足"] is False
    for module_id in ("02", "05", "07", "11"):
        assert modules[module_id]["模块状态"] == "NOT_ASSESSABLE"
        assert modules[module_id]["报告资格"] == "NOT_REPORTABLE"

    banned = ("待医学标定", "不生成", "AI辅助", "非医学诊断", "candidate/uncalibrated", "legacy_shadow_score")
    for key in ("user_docx", "doctor_docx"):
        path = Path(output[key])
        text = _all_text(path)
        assert all(word not in text for word in banned)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
            xml = archive.read("word/document.xml").decode("utf-8")
        assert "w:bookmarkStart" in xml
        assert "w:hyperlink" in xml
        assert "TOC" in xml
        assert "w:tblBorders" in xml
        assert "/home/" not in xml

    index = json.loads((result / "九项检测结果索引.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert index["医学报告"]["状态"] == "success"
    assert index["双版报告"]["状态"] == "success"


def test_dual_report_rejects_unready_profile(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    result = tmp_path / "sample"
    _result(result)
    profile = tmp_path / "profile.json"
    profile.write_text(json.dumps({
        "scoring_profile_version": "aisia_scoring_v0.1.1_integrity_test_20260806",
        "profile_ready": False,
    }), encoding="utf-8")
    try:
        generate_dual_reports_from_review_result(result, profile)
    except RuntimeError as exc:
        assert "profile_ready" in str(exc)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("未就绪常模必须被拒绝")
